sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 14 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：IBM、SPY、MU、MSFT、ORCL。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • IBM plunged -25.7% intraday ($215.71), its worst single day since October 1987 and its largest percentage drop since 1968. The company pre-announced Q2 revenue of $17.2 billion (expected $17.86 billion) and adjusted EPS of $2.93 (expected $3.01); CEO Krishna bluntly stated that in late June, customers shifted capital spending from software to server/storage/memory to rush-buy scarce capacity. SaaS/consulting was dragged down across the board: NOW -4.4%, ADBE -3.6%, CRM -1.6%, MSFT -1.2%, ORCL -1.6%; official earnings are on 7/22.
  • June CPI cooled sharply but was called “one-off”: CPI was 3.5% YoY (expected 3.8%, prior 4.2%), -0.4% MoM (the largest drop since April 2020), with core MoM flat and YoY at 2.6%. The decline was almost entirely driven by the energy index at -5.7% (oil prices had at one point fallen about 25% from the peak). The community broadly deemed it “cooked CPI,” because the Hormuz conflict has restarted and the oil price base effect will be replenished.
  • Trump’s TACO cycle replayed: Yesterday’s threat to impose a $15/barrel transit fee on ships passing through the strait drove oil prices higher; today he reversed course and replaced the fee with Gulf trade/investment agreements, sending oil back down — OXY -1.2%, USO only +0.5%. Intraday, Trump also reposted a three-week-old article about a “military victory,” triggering an instant algorithmic spike and reversal; the community joked that the market had been manipulated by tweets into a “shitcoin.”
  • Warsh testified before Congress for the first time as Fed Chair: He repeatedly emphasized that “the first goal of monetary policy is to get it right” and “no bailouts for anyone, including crypto,” while dodging the rate-cut path and Basel III. His language was criticized as hollow (the “task force” meme flooded the chat). Indices weakened every time he opened his mouth.
  • Bank earnings opened strong: JPM Q2 EPS of $7.70 (expected $5.59) and revenue of $58.0 billion massively beat expectations, with investment banking and trading posting strong results; shares rose +2.7% ($343). GS +7.7% ($1126) led the banks. QQQ +1.3% ($721) held up on semiconductor strength, SPY +0.45% ($752), DIA was basically flat, and IWM +0.5%.
  • Korean memory frenzy spilled over: SKHY (Hynix ADR) +16.4% ($178.5), with Barclays rumored to have a $330 price target; the ADR traded at a premium of over 30% to Korean shares. It lifted MU +3.9%, SNDK +4.6%, AMD +5.3%, KLAC +4.2%.

社区氛围：总体而言，社区处于一种欣喜若狂、疲惫不堪的混乱状态——IBM的爆料围绕着“60,000%看跌期权传说”制造了黑色幽默，CPI有利但仍无法阻止日内反复的灯芯，大多数人抱怨“假泵假转储，无法交易”。人们的情绪不断在幸灾乐祸（嘲笑空头和 IBM 多头）和自嘲损失之间跳跃。

恐惧/贪婪：有贪婪倾向，但极度分裂。绿色指数加上强大的银行和半导体支持了贪婪的一面；但 IBM 的倒闭、SaaS 和 Neocloud 名称的持续流失，以及 VIX 指数的奇怪下跌，都让人们感到不安。

社区情绪与实际市场行为：社区大喊“CPI 是假的”和“没有人相信这个数据”，但实际的市场行为（SPY/QQQ 走高，TLT 适度上涨 0.5%）表明市场基本上接受了降温的说法 - 只是不想追至 750 以上。评论中的“崩溃论点”显然与适度绿色磁带的现实背道而驰。

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
IBM90+看跌暴跌-25.7%至215美元，为1987年以来最严重的跌幅； “SaaS 金丝雀”、“婴儿潮一代股票追随 INTC 的道路”，底部出现两位数；逢低买家押注 210-212 的空头反弹 3-15%，官方财报将于 7 月 22 日公布；许多看涨期权与 60,000% 的看跌期权传说一起归零
SKHY40+看涨+16.4%至178美元，巴克莱传闻目标为330美元；调侃为模因币，ADR溢价超30%，“KOSPI今晚接管”；杠杆ETF仅涨1.3%，引发FOMO和追高争论
MU35+看涨（分开）+3.9%，反复推向1000美元但未能突破，45分钟暴力995→950走势；隔夜拉升、盘中抛售是“第三个假泵”；多头相信基本面，但一些人转而买入看跌期权
NBIS30+看跌-4.4%并跌破200美元；宣布新的10亿美元数据中心订单，但仍被抛售； “好消息是利空”，“neocloud 没有盈利故事”，社区持有者自嘲，看着 190/160 的支持
MSFT25+中性的-1.2%，被称为“逆SPY/新逆指标”； “如果明天是绿色的，市场就会是红色的”；下跌买家表示，在软件品牌中，他们更愿意购买 MSFT；崩溃后从-3%恢复到-1.5%
SNDK15+看涨+4.6%，但从盘中高点回落3-4%，“不间断的牛市陷阱”；内存名称上涨，DRAM选项被诅咒为垃圾
ORCL15+看跌-1.6%，环比下降约50%； “-2% 算作绿色日”，“算法在开盘时将其固定下来”；重仓持有者抱怨股息无法弥补跌幅
GS12看涨+7.7% 领先银行，强劲的投资银行/交易； “DJ CEO”模因，有人昨天买了今天卖了，赚了 25,000 美元来偿还债务
